servings: 1 person; portions sized for ~2,300-2,500 kcal/day (desk day). Quantities are summed from meals.json ingredient grams for the 14-day plan; for field days add the optional field-day snacks.
notes: Approximate. Fresh produce and grain quantities are edible/cooked weights from USDA FDC; buy a little extra to allow for peels/trim. Pantry staples (olive oil, spices) may already be on hand. Backups are similar-nutrition substitutes from meals.json.
